steps.eval: (async()=>{ window.__until=async(fn,ms)=>{const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ const r=fn(); if(r) return r; await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,100)); } return null;}; __rhf.game.debugEagle = true; const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let k=0;k<10&&f.state==='idle';k++){ __rhf.press('primary'); await __until(()=>f.state!=='idle',15000); } return 'cast: '+f.state; })()
steps.label: pressing to cast starts the power meter

steps.eval: (async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; f.meter.t = Math.pow(0.6,1/1.3)*1.15 - 0.1; __rhf.press('primary'); await __until(()=>f.meter.phase===1||f.state!=='meter',60000); return 'power press: phase '+f.meter.phase+', power '+f.meter.power.toFixed(2); })()
steps.label: the power press sets a mid power and moves to the timing bar

steps.eval: (async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const m=f.meter; if(f.state==='meter'&&m.phase===1){ m.t=0.5/f.timing.speed-0.05; __rhf.press('primary'); } await __until(()=>f.state!=='meter',60000); return 'timing tap: '+f.state+' at '+(0.5+m.acc).toFixed(2); })()
steps.label: a timing tap near the centre releases the cast
the lure lands and the line waits

steps.eval: (async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<300000){ if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='bite'){ __rhf.press('primary'); return 'hooked after '+((performance.now()-t0)/1000).toFixed(0)+' s'; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='approach'){ f.encounter.t=f.encounter.dur; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='nibble'){ f.encounter.nibbles=0; f.encounter.gap=0; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return 'no bite '+f.state})()
steps.label: a fish bites and is hooked

steps.eval: (async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; await __until(()=>f.state!=='waiting',300000); const t0=performance.now(); while(f.state==='fight' && performance.now()-t0<300000){ const F=f.fight; F.fish.weight=Math.min(F.fish.weight,1.8); F.fish.legend=null; F.stamina=0.2; F.dist=Math.min(F.dist,3); F.state='tired'; F.stateT=5; __rhf.hold('primary', true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); } __rhf.hold('primary', false); return 'state '+f.state})()
steps.label: the small fish is fought in and landed (or already being snatched)

steps.eval: (async()=>{const w=__rhf.game.wildlife; const P=__rhf.game.player.pos; const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<300000){ const b=w.birds.find(b=>b.mode==='swoop'); if(b){ const d=Math.hypot(b.x-P.x,b.y-P.y,b.z-P.z); if(d<26) return 'swoop close '+d.toFixed(1)+' t '+b.t.toFixed(2); } else if (w.birds.find(b=>b.mode==='carry')) return 'already carry'; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40)); } return 'no swoop, state '+__rhf.game.fishing.state})()
steps.label: the bald eagle swoops in close for the fish

steps.eval: (async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const w=g.wildlife; const out=[]; const V=g.camera.position.constructor; const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<300000){ const b=w.birds.find(b=>b.mode==='carry'); if(b && out.length<8 && b.t> out.length*0.5){ const v=new V(b.x,b.y,b.z).project(g.camera); out.push('t'+b.t.toFixed(1)+' ndc '+v.x.toFixed(2)+','+v.y.toFixed(2)+' d '+Math.hypot(b.x-g.camera.position.x,b.y-g.camera.position.y,b.z-g.camera.position.z).toFixed(0)); } if(out.length>=8) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,30)); } return out.join(' | ')})()
steps.label: the eagle carries the fish off: stays in view and flies away
steps.expect: (() => { const e = r.split(' | '); if (e.length !== 8) return false; const v = e.map((s) => s.match(/^t([\d.]+) ndc (-?[\d.]+),(-?[\d.]+) d (\d+)$/)); return v.every((m) => m && Math.abs(+m[2]) <= 1 && Math.abs(+m[3]) <= 1) && +v[7][4] > +v[0][4]; })()

steps.label: the fish is gone: fishing back to idle and one fish counted stolen
